title: Iced Instant Black Decaf Tea Sweetened with Low-Calorie Sweetener

content.title: About
content.content: This is a caffeine‑free instant black tea designed for cold preparation. The dry powder dissolves quickly in cold water, creating a refreshing drink with a sweet taste provided by the low‑calorie sweetener (5250).

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Black tea is the world’s second most consumed beverage after water.
Decaffeination preserves most flavor compounds while removing caffeine.
Instant tea was invented in the early 20th century and became popular for its convenience.
Low‑calorie sweeteners allow a sweet taste with reduced energy content.
Iced instant tea is often used in sports drinks and cocktails.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Black tea contains polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Caffeine‑free
items.content: The lack of caffeine makes it suitable for people sensitive to stimulants.

items.title: Supports hydration
items.content: A cold beverage helps maintain fluid balance, especially in hot weather.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: Sweetener 5250 provides sweetness without significantly increasing calories.

items.title: May aid digestion
items.content: Tannins in black tea can help normalize digestive processes.

items.title: Tea allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to tea components.

items.title: Sweetener sensitivity
items.content: Although low‑calorie, the sweetener may cause gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive people.

items.title: Tannin content
items.content: High tannin intake can reduce iron absorption when consumed in large amounts.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Dissolve one serving (about 2 g) in 200 ml of cold water, stir or shake well. Drink it as is, or use it as a base for cocktails, smoothies, or fruit punches.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the sachets or jar of powder in a dry, cool place away from moisture and direct sunlight. After opening, keep the package tightly sealed to prevent moisture absorption.
